parameters.name: import.min.file.age
parameters.description: Ignore files younger than this, so half-written files are not picked up.

parameters.name: import.error.dir
parameters.description: Files that could not be processed (no feed folder, database unreachable).

parameters.name: granite.db.url
parameters.description: JDBC URL of the client Granite database. Change server, port and databaseName.

parameters.name: import.inbound.dir
parameters.description: Drop folder. One sub-folder per feed, e.g. Inbound\SalesOrder.

parameters.name: import.archive.dir
parameters.description: Every received file is copied here, by feed and month.
